name: The Occult
overview: Scripture clearly condemns involvement with the occult, warning God's people against witchcraft, familiar spirits, and wizardry, as seen in commands to not suffer witches to live (Exodus 22:18) and prohibitions against seeking out wizards or those with familiar spirits (Leviticus 19:31; 20:6, 20:27). The Lord instructs His people to avoid adopting the abominable practices of surrounding nations (Deuteronomy 18:9) and cautions against turning to the heavenly bodies for worship or guidance (Deuteronomy 4:19). Such practices are not only defiling but provoke God's judgment and separation from His covenant community.
